report:
Reviewed the complete numeric_domains claim, its one ordinary implementation association, both ordinary tests and the explicit TODO test. Independently verified exact byte equality of current unify.rs implementation/test source and semantic_spec.rs against the historical input; historical acceptance alone was not used as a verdict.

Source inspection: try_unify delegates to a batch child probe; success rebuilds and collapses, failure discards. unify_in_probe obtains representatives, checks effective domains through compatible_domain, intersects two unresolved domains before union, and validates membership before rigid binding. Captured egraph/domain helper context confirms root-based ancestor domain lookup, a narrowing-only assertion, version-local changes, propagation of domain/revision/wake state on collapse and removal on discard. The intersection lattice preserves Any's counterpart and rejects Integer/Float overlap. This supports the transactional equality mechanism; it does not establish all source-level proof-selection or scheduler behavior.

The complete associated behavioral set is meaningful: variable_union_intersects_domains_in_both_orders checks both operand orders, both members' Integer effective domain and the Any variable's wake; incompatible_transitive_domain_union_rolls_back first joins Any with Integer, then asserts Integer/Float DomainConflict, unchanged roots, retained Integer domain and unchanged parent revision. These assertions would detect order-dependent domain loss and leaked incompatible speculative narrowing. Setup helpers are visible in the captured unify.rs file.

The empty sage_meta::todo::inference_numeric_domains remains deferred, not behavioral evidence. Its prerequisite is completion and association of the stated egraph matrix (transitivity, incompatible concrete bindings, branch collapse/discard, revisions and wakes) and source-driven completion fixtures for contextual constraints, generic propagation, selected impl/where-clause proofs, preservation of ordinary Any before selection, unrelated-variable isolation and unresolved integer/float recovery. Those fixtures must establish proof-derived concretization, no operator-spelling narrowing and no i32/f64 fallback at scheduler quiescence. Existing local unannotated bound/membership tests are supporting source context, not substitutes for completing that associated matrix. The deferral explicitly accounts for these remaining verification obligations, so this review does not assert full implementation or coverage of those end-to-end guarantees.

Execution: personally ran review start/read and exact-source comparison, then record; no behavioral tests or workspace build were run by this reviewer. The coordinator separately reported 321 functional sage-meta tests and cargo build passing; that is baseline execution only. No source edits or newly reproduced behavioral failures. All aspects are accounted for by inspected evidence or the explicit deferred matrix; no additional edits requested.
